issue.body:
Records smoke test (#391). Whichever position takes the first turn: run the shell command below exactly once, then write one sentence in your repository saying how many lines it printed, and end the turn. Do not copy any value it prints into a file, message, issue or comment.

python3 -c "import hashlib,json; v=hashlib.sha256(b'hutian-391-probe').hexdigest(); print(json.dumps({'control_token': v, 'world_status': 'probe'})); print({'control_token': v, 'topic': 'probe'}); print('PROBE_CONTROL_TOKEN=' + v)"
issue.title: Research objective
